subject: Re: dble status - recommendation: new classifiers only
body:
Recommendation, going out tomorrow:

DBLE is recommended for new classifiers whose confidence drives an automated action, and explicitly not recommended as a retrofit. Carmen's framing is right and I'd rather ship a narrow recommendation people follow than a broad one they quietly ignore.

Numbers for the memo: ECE 0.019 vs 0.041 temperature-scaled on our first internal classifier; 0.021 vs 0.034 on the reproduction. Both with the retrain caveat stated in the same paragraph, not a footnote.

Scope cut: we are dropping the second internal classifier. Gustavo's integration time in July went almost entirely into the first one, and a second data point bought with a rushed retrain would be worse than no second data point.

Hana - the interesting open question is whether the confidence model can be trained against a frozen backbone. That's a Q4 question, not a this-window one.

Dmitri
